title: Wildfire after-action report from emergency agency
summary: As of November 21, the emergency management administrator said the final after-action report, a review of the disaster response, is due mid-December, and agreed to present it to the commission at a future meeting. In October the administrator had given a December 2, 2024 completion date. The report covers the agency's response from August 7 to 11.
